config.label_policy: Filenames/pitch labels only determine splits and evaluation. Fitting functions accept waveform and configuration only.
config.evaluation_policy: Freeze configuration after development. Each evaluation waveform is fitted at inference; this is not evaluation of a globally trained network. No claims of unseen-instrument generalisation.
config.success_policy: Report all samples and failures. No requirement that the differentiable method beat YIN.
config.development_revision: Initial octave-search development failed on 3/4 pitch labels despite lower spectral loss; constrain refinement around YIN without using reference labels at inference. Initial evidence retained in results/development_initial.
